Plugin Reference > wgpu — Browser WebGPU Sidecar

wgpu — Browser WebGPU Sidecar

Zig 0.17This plugin is built with Zig 0.17: the 0.17 branch builds with Zig 0.17 and passes the Zig unit tests; the old 0.14.1 branch is kept unchanged.

sa_plugin_wgpu is a browser WebGPU sidecar plugin aimed at SAX. The design principle is to keep the WebGPU kernel material on the SA/WASM side: the wgpu_airlock.js broker only handles browser-specific operations (navigator.gpu, GPU object handles, byte uploads, command submission); WGSL, vertex/index bytes, uniform frames, and frame selection are all generated by SA/WASM.

Basic facts

  • Capability segments: wgpu, sax.wgpu; depends on sax (required).
  • Permissions: read/write/create in the project directory; no network, no child processes.
  • Contracts: wgpu.sai is the browser WASM import surface (so libwgpu.so is not required to export sa_wgpu_*), and wgpu.sal provides SA-side descriptor constructors and layout constants (such as WGPU_RENDER_PIPELINE_DESC_SIZE, WGPU_DRAW_DESC_SIZE).

Commands

CommandDescription
sa wgpu airlock [--out path]Output the wgpu_airlock.js broker
sa wgpu check file.saxValidate a SAX scene file
sa wgpu new dirGenerate a new project skeleton

How to enable it

# 安装（会按 sap.json 一并安装 sax 依赖）
SA_PLUGIN_DEV=1 sa plugin install --dev .

# 正式安装后，SAX 可从 $SA_PLUGINS_HOME 发现 sidecar，无需手动设置 SA_PLUGINS_PATH
sa sax build demos/rotating_cube.sax --out-dir dist

# 显式指定 share 目录的替代方式
SA_WGPU_SHARE_DIR=/path/to/wgpu/share sa sax build ...

The shared WGPU contract (v0.1 summary)

  • sa_wgpu_create_buffer — corresponds to the Bevy-style create_buffer_with_data upload path.
  • sa_wgpu_create_shader — creates a shader module; the WGSL still belongs to SA/WASM.
  • sa_wgpu_create_render_pipeline / sa_wgpu_submit_indexed_draw — read SA descriptors (WGPU_RENDER_PIPELINE_DESC / WGPU_DRAW_DESC) to build the pipeline and submit the render pass and indexed draw.
  • sa_wgpu_create_cube_pipeline / sa_wgpu_submit_cube_frame — compatibility wrappers for the rotating-cube demo, reusing the same pipeline/draw helpers.
WarningThis is still not a complete WebGPU engine: compute pipelines, textures, render graph scheduling, multi-pass compositing, and high-performance dashboard primitives are all future work. The v0.1 acceptance target is fixed as a rotating 3D cube on a 1024×768 canvas.
